name: Paris, France

visa.notes: Long-stay visa requires ~€1,500/mo income. Must apply at French consulate.

rent.notes: Paris average ~33 EUR/m2 (SeLoger Jan 2026 via Lemonade, 26-43 by arrondissement): 70 m2 T3 ~2,300 EUR, 80-90 m2 ~2,700-3,000 EUR; Numbeo 3BR centre avg 3,324 EUR (2,600-4,120). OLL 2024 median 24.2 EUR/m2 is the rent-controlled floor. Pet-friendly 2-3BR in outer arrondissements is the typical.

sources.title: Les loyers du parc prive en France 2026 (OLL 2024 data)

groceries.notes: Couple grocery average ~530 EUR/mo (INSEE-based, 400-650 range) plus ~70-90 EUR/mo large-breed dog food. Paris food prices run ~10% above the national average. Food CPI +1.2% y/y Oct 2026 (INSEE), so no inflation uplift applied.

utilities.notes: Gas-heated 70-85 m2 apartment: gas prix repere Nov 2026 0.1576 EUR/kWh + 30.07 EUR/mo subscription (~8,000 kWh/yr = ~135 EUR/mo) plus electricity ~2,500 kWh/yr at TRV 0.2001 EUR/kWh + subscription ~55 EUR/mo, water ~35 EUR (estimate), trash via charges ~15 EUR. Collective heating in charges can replace the gas line. Excludes internet.

sources.title: Hello Watt - prix repere gaz novembre 2026

healthcare.notes: Old template put health cover under insurance; full cost now here. Two residents on PUMa plus a mid/high-tier mutuelle at age 60-64 (65-95 EUR medium, 82-125 EUR strong, ~125 EUR avg at 55-64 per Magnolia), x2. Caution: non-pensioners living on capital income above 24,030 EUR can owe the cotisation subsidiaire maladie (up to 6.5% of capital income over the threshold); exempt if either spouse receives a retirement pension.

sources.title: Indy - simulateur taxe PUMa / cotisation subsidiaire maladie 2026

insurance.notes: Re-modelled from old health-insurance template to renters/contents (assurance habitation locataire). LeLynx 2026: tenant T3 apartment ~118 EUR/yr nationally, Ile-de-France all-profile avg ~162 EUR/yr; typical allows a 2-3BR with higher contents cover.

petCare.notes: Routine vet for a healthy adult dog 500-1000 EUR/yr incl. 150-300 EUR prevention (consult 30-60 EUR, annual vaccine visit 60-100 EUR, antiparasitics/wormers 100-200 EUR/yr); large-dog dosing pushes to the upper half. Excludes food and pet insurance.

petDaycare.notes: Ile-de-France pension canine 30-45 EUR/day (more for premium); ~2-3 weeks boarding/yr plus a few daycare days = ~120 EUR/mo averaged.

petGrooming.notes: Full groom (bath + brush/clip) for a large long-haired dog ~75 EUR per session (SanteVet grid, Dec 2025), giant breeds often billed hourly; every 6-10 weeks for a Bernese double coat.

transportation.notes: Car-free: two Navigo monthly passes at 90.80 EUR (2026). Navigo Senior (544.80 EUR/yr, ~45 EUR/mo) needs age 62+ and non-working, so not yet at 60. Min = one pass plus pay-as-you-go; max = keeping a car in Paris (fuel, 49 EUR/mo insurance, maintenance, parking).

entertainment.notes: Fibre box 22.99-49.99 EUR (avg 35 EUR) + ~30 EUR streaming + dining out for two ~3x/mo at ~80-90 EUR in Paris + ~75 EUR museums/cinema/activities.

clothing.notes: Ifop 2025: French consumers spend 256 EUR/yr (store shoppers) to 415 EUR/yr (online shoppers) per person on clothing; two adults = 45-70 EUR/mo, max allows coastal/city wardrobe refresh.

sources.title: Journal de l'Economie / Ifop - depenses habillement 2025

personalCare.notes: Hairdressing ~282 EUR/yr per client (6.6 visits at 42.70 EUR, FIDUCIAL 2026), men's cut 25-30 EUR; plus ~20-30 EUR/person/mo toiletries (estimate). Two adults.

sources.title: Modeles de business plan - marche coiffure (FIDUCIAL 2026)

phoneCell.notes: Two SIM-only lines: 100-110 GB 5G plans at 12.99-13.99 EUR each (Free, B&You, Sosh, Sept 2026); min is two bare-bones 2 EUR plans plus margin, max is two premium carrier plans.

sources.title: Ariase - forfaits mobiles les moins chers sept 2026

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: Franchises + participations forfaitaires capped at 140 EUR/yr per person from Oct 2026; DREES 2025 average out-of-pocket 495 EUR/person/yr of which ~112 EUR routine care and 52 EUR devices (LTC and medicines excluded here). Two adults with some dental/optical overrun beyond mutuelle.

sources.title: Selectra - DREES reste a charge 495 EUR 2025

healthcare.system: French Sécurité Sociale. AP-HP is the largest hospital system in Europe. World-class specialist care available.
healthcare.waitTimes: GPs: same day to 1 week. Specialists: 1-4 weeks. Best access in France.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: 70% covered by Sécu, remainder by mutuelle

pros.text: World-class public transit: 16-line métro + RER + bus network operated under Île-de-France Mobilités (~1.5 billion annual métro riders)

sources.title: Île-de-France Mobilités — Paris regional transit network
RATP — Métro de Paris (16 lines, ~225 km, ~1.5 billion annual riders)

pros: International city with huge expat community

cons.text: Very high cost of living, especially rent
Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country

taxes.notes: French progressive income tax 11%-45%. Social charges ~9.1% on foreign income.
